verdict.rationale: Daytona's pricing page frames billing as usage-based: sandboxes spin up and shut down in milliseconds, "use what you need, when you need it," with included free compute. That points to paying only for compute used, but the pack never states per-second granularity or what metrics are billed. missing for 10: explicit per-second billing granularity, documented per-resource (vCPU/RAM/disk/GPU) rates, confirmation that stopped/idle sandboxes are not billed for compute, independent or hands-on corroboration of billing behavior.
